spawn-tuner.intro: Unticked settings stay at the world's own value. Percent: 100% is vanilla, 200% is double, 0% turns it off.
spawn-tuner.after: Put it in the mod folder, then type  spawns reload  and  spawns refresh  in the server console.

hints.*Density: none, default, or a number (the game's range is 1 to 5)

blood-moon-sound.intro: Your own sound files still go in the mod folder next to this file.
blood-moon-sound.after: Put it in the mod folder, then type  bmsound reload  or restart the game.

blood-moon-sound.title: Discord posts
blood-moon-sound.summary: Paste your Discord webhook, pick which blood moon posts you want and how they read, and download a ready discord.txt for your server.
blood-moon-sound.intro: Server only: players don't need this file. Every message can use the placeholders below, and the first line of a message is its headline. \n starts a new line.
blood-moon-sound.after: Put it in the mod folder on the server (never in a zip you give players), then type  bmdiscord reload  and  bmdiscord test  in the server console.

hints.LeaderboardHour: Hour on the server PC's own clock, 0 to 23
hints.*EveryHours: In-game hours between posts, 0 to 24 (0 = off)
hints.InGameChatFor: Comma separated: reminder, countdown, start, update, end, death, laststanding, leaderboard, schedule, serverstart, serverstop, join, leave, or all

remove-any-entity.intro: Pick what stops spawning, what stops only in some biomes, and what gets swapped for something else. A name covers all its versions (feral, radiated, charged, infernal).
remove-any-entity.after: Put it in the mod folder on the server, then type  rae reload  in the server console.

hints.Replacement: Spawned instead when removals leave a spawn spot with nothing at all

zombie-and-animal-bait.title: Discord posts
zombie-and-animal-bait.summary: Paste your Discord webhook, pick which Bait posts you want (tames, levels, evolutions, retirements, Alphas) and how they read, or turn them all off, and download a ready webhook.txt.
zombie-and-animal-bait.intro: Server only. Already running Blood Moon Sound with a discord.txt? Leave the URL empty and Bait posts to that webhook, with the choices below. Every message can use the placeholders below; \n starts a new line, and an empty message uses the standard one.
zombie-and-animal-bait.after: Put it in the mod folder on the server (never in a zip you give players), then type  /thrall admin webhook reload  in game chat as an admin, or restart the server.  /thrall admin webhook test  sends a test post.

hints.Enabled: off stops every Bait post, even with a webhook in Blood Moon Sound's discord.txt
hints.PostTames: rare = radiated, charged, infernal, bosses and demolishers; all = every tame; off = none
hints.TameMinLevel: Only post tames of this level or more (0 = any)
hints.LevelEvery: Post at every multiple of this level, like 50, 100, 150 (0 = never)
hints.MsgAlphaTamed: Posted when an Alpha is tamed: {player}, {alpha}, {creature}, {level}

fallback.summary: Paste your Discord webhook and download a ready webhook.txt, so rare tames, level milestones and evolutions are posted to your channel.
fallback.intro: Server only. Already running Blood Moon Sound with a discord.txt? Bait uses that webhook when it has no webhook.txt, so you can skip this.
fallback.after: Put it in the mod folder on the server (never in a zip you give players), then restart the server.

turret-claim-guard.after: Put it in the mod folder on the server, then type  tcg reload  in the server console.

hints.Protect: Which land claims stop turrets damaging blocks: own (the turret owner's), allies (owner's plus their allies'), any (every active claim) or off (vanilla)
hints.BlockTurrets: The placed auto turret, shotgun turret and M60 turret
hints.JunkTurrets: The robotics junk turret and junk sledge
hints.LogBlocked: Write a server log line for every blocked hit. For testing only

repair-pad.after: Put it in the mod folder on the server, then type  rpad reload  in the server console.

hints.CostMode: materials: each block costs what a repair hammer would (concrete mix for concrete, forged iron for steel). kits: repair kits
hints.HpPerKit: Kits mode only: hit points one repair kit restores, spread over as many blocks as it covers
hints.KitItem: Kits mode only: the item that counts as a repair kit
hints.CooldownSeconds: Seconds before the same pad can run again
hints.RequirePower: The pad only works while it has electrical power
hints.RepairsPerFrame: Blocks repaired per frame. Lower it if a big repair causes a hitch on your server
hints.LogRuns: Write a server log line for every pad run
